from cache import make_key

def test_make_key_all_inputs_affect():
    """Test that all three inputs affect the key"""
    key1 = make_key("text", "profile", "criteria")
    key2 = make_key("text", "profile", "criteria")
    key3 = make_key("text", "profile2", "criteria")  # changed profile
    key4 = make_key("text", "profile", "criteria")  # unchanged
    
    assert key1 == key2, "Same inputs should produce same key"
    assert key1 != key3, "Changed profile should produce different key"
    assert key1 == key4, "Unchanged inputs should produce same key"

def test_none_values():
    """Test that None values work correctly"""
    key1 = make_key("text", None, "criteria")
    key2 = make_key("text", "profile", None)
    key3 = make_key("text", None, None)
    
    assert key1 != key2, "None profile vs criteria should differ"
    assert key1 != key3, "None vs None should differ"
    assert key2 != key3, "Different None positions should differ"

def test_tuple_equality():
    """Test tuple-based key comparison"""
    key1 = make_key("a", 1, 2)
    key2 = make_key("a", 1, 2)
    key3 = make_key("b", 1, 2)
    
    assert key1 == key2, "Identical inputs should have identical keys"
    assert key1 != key3, "Different text should have different keys"

    test_none_values()
